tasks.label: Run ASR markers Playwright test (web server)
tasks.command: PORT=8080 python3 dev/web_viewer/serve_with_headers.py & echo $! > /tmp/dev_web_viewer_server.pid && timeout 900s npx playwright test --project=web_viewer-root-e2e dev/web_viewer/e2e-ultimate-markers-asr.spec.js --reporter=line; kill $(cat /tmp/dev_web_viewer_server.pid) 2>/dev/null || true

tasks.label: Run ASR markers Playwright test (Vite dev)
tasks.command: USE_VITE=1 USE_VITE_PORT=${USE_VITE_PORT:-5180} timeout 900s npx playwright test --project=web_viewer-root-e2e dev/web_viewer/e2e-ultimate-markers-asr.spec.js --reporter=line

tasks.label: Run ASR markers Playwright test (Vite self-serve)
Run Ultimate Conversation E2E (web server)
tasks.command: PORT=8080 python3 dev/web_viewer/serve_with_headers.py & echo $! > /tmp/dev_web_viewer_server.pid && timeout 900s npx playwright test --project=web_viewer-root-e2e dev/web_viewer/e2e-ultimate-conversation.spec.js --reporter=line; kill $(cat /tmp/dev_web_viewer_server.pid) 2>/dev/null || true

tasks.label: Run Ultimate Conversation E2E (real, web server)
tasks.command: PORT=8080 python3 dev/web_viewer/serve_with_headers.py & echo $! > /tmp/dev_web_viewer_server.pid && timeout 900s bash -lc 'RUN_REAL_INFERENCE=1 npx playwright test --project=web_viewer-root-e2e dev/web_viewer/e2e-ultimate-conversation-real.spec.js --reporter=line'; kill $(cat /tmp/dev_web_viewer_server.pid) 2>/dev/null || true
